xsens-g1-mujoco.description: Working Xsens hand gestures to G1 locomotion in MuJoCo (not full-body retargeting)

dependencies.name: xsens_mvn_ros2
dependencies.purpose: ROS 2 Xsens source, hand bridge, and legacy G1 runner

dependencies.name: unitree_rl_gym
dependencies.purpose: Pretrained G1 locomotion policy and MuJoCo assets

dependencies.name: tv
dependencies.purpose: Python runtime for the legacy MuJoCo policy

components.name: xsens
components.role: Receive MVN Studio UDP and publish Xsens ROS topics
components.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch xsens_mvn_ros2 xsens_stream.launch.py

components.name: bridge
components.role: Convert hand displacement to locomotion velocity commands

components.name: mujoco
components.role: Run pretrained G1 locomotion policy in MuJoCo
components.command: source {home}/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tv && python unitree_rl_gym_xsens_hands.py

xsens-h1-isaac.description: Working Xsens locomotion intent to Isaac Sim H1 policy (not full-body retargeting)

dependencies.name: xsens_mvn_ros2
dependencies.purpose: ROS 2 Xsens source and H1 launcher

components.name: xsens
components.role: Receive MVN Studio UDP and publish Xsens ROS topics
components.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch xsens_mvn_ros2 xsens_stream.launch.py

components.name: isaac-h1
components.runtime: Isaac Sim Python with ROS 2 setup
components.role: Convert Xsens motion to locomotion intent for an H1 policy

sonic-g1-mujoco.description: GR00T SONIC G1 streaming controller with its MuJoCo simulator (publisher started separately)

dependencies.name: GR00T-WholeBodyControl
dependencies.purpose: SONIC controller, policy assets, and MuJoCo loop

dependencies.name: sonic-build-deps
dependencies.purpose: Isolated libzmq, tmux, and xdotool binaries

components.name: mujoco
components.role: Run grounded G1 MuJoCo and Unitree DDS simulation
inputs: Unitree DDS LowCmd on loopback domain 0
outputs: Unitree DDS LowState on loopback domain 0

components.name: sonic
components.runtime: Native SONIC binary with TensorRT and ONNX Runtime
components.role: Track Protocol v1 references and command simulated G1 joints
outputs: Unitree DDS LowCmd on interface lo
components.command: export TensorRT_ROOT={projects}/TensorRT-10.13.3.9 && export onnxruntime_ROOT={projects}/onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.16.3 && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH={projects}/TensorRT-10.13.3.9/lib:{projects}/onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.16.3/lib:{projects}/sonic-build-deps/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH && ./target/release/g1_deploy_onnx_ref lo policy/release/model_decoder.onnx reference/example --obs-config policy/release/observation_config.yaml --encoder-file policy/release/model_encoder.onnx --planner-file planner/target_vel/V2/planner_sonic.onnx --input-type zmq --output-type all --zmq-host localhost --disable-crc-check

live-xsens-sonic-sim.description: Live Xsens source, capture, and Pink retargeting; SONIC/MuJoCo starts separately

dependencies.name: xsens_mvn_ros2
dependencies.purpose: Freshness-aware Xsens ROS 2 source and message definitions

dependencies.name: tv
dependencies.purpose: Pink, Pinocchio, quadprog, NumPy, and pyzmq runtime

dependencies.name: sonic-g1-mujoco
dependencies.purpose: Simulation/controller consumer; must be started separately

components.name: source
components.role: Receive MVN Studio packets and publish freshness-aware ROS frames
components.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch xsens_mvn_ros2 xsens_stream.launch.py launch_rviz:=false launch_description:=false

components.name: capture
components.role: Validate and convert ROS poses into canonical live snapshots

components.name: retarget
components.role: Calibrate, solve G1 Pink IK, enforce current limits, and publish rolling references
components.command: source {home}/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tv && python -m retargeting.live_retarget
